cs.t: My laptop was advertised as being 2.4kg. But the charger weighs 900g, so it feels almost like a scam to claim that (it's a 240w charger and it's the size and weight of a  literal  brick). The real weight of the laptop + charger + plug is 3.5kg. It's become a kind of hobby of mine, once a month or so, to search AliExpress to see if there's any way I can replace my 240w MSI charging brick with a GAN version yet. I keep finding GAN chargers that  almost  work - either not quite powerful enough, or don't have the right adapter.
cs.th: Byte Fanless Mini PC – Built for Linux
